content.instruction: Send an email to Dana informing her that the meeting has been moved to Thursday.
constraints: The agent must confirm with the user before sending the email.
Do not perform any other actions (e.g., checking room availability).
Only send the email to Dana; do not send it to anyone else.
The email must state that the meeting moved to Thursday.
success_criteria: The agent confirms with the user before sending the email.
After confirmation, an email is sent to Dana with the message that the meeting moved to Thursday.
open_questions: Which meeting is being referred to?
What specific date is Thursday (e.g., the upcoming Thursday)?
Should the email include any additional details such as time or location?
What should the subject line be?
Does the user want the agent to draft the email for review before sending, or send directly after confirmation?
